'''Spooky:) More Dangerus Then You Realize''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Spooky:)]]
* '''Published:''' 12 June 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Dantooine Base Operations / More Dangerous Than You Realize|SE-L-dantooinebaseoperations.gif|label=Dantooine Base Operations}}
* '''Strategy:''' Dantooine Base Operations
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 Dantooine Base Operations Spooky).txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This is a basic squadron deck:)

The published list has 58 cards.
